verdictEs: Exiled Exchange 2 si querés el sucesor espiritual directo de Awakened PoE Trade enfocado solo en price-check rápido. POE Overlay si necesitás features extra: historial de mercado, integración de servicios de carry y un toolkit más amplio dentro del mismo overlay.
verdictEn: Exiled Exchange 2 if you want the direct spiritual successor of Awakened PoE Trade, focused only on fast price-checking. POE Overlay if you need extra features: market history, carry services integration, and a broader toolkit inside the same overlay.

useCases.reasonEn: EE2 mirrors APT's hotkeys, layout, and flow almost 1:1. Zero re-learning curve.
